description: Déversoir d'orage (déversement temps SEC) d'Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes et le bassin Rhône Méditerranée is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administrateur de Données (Direction Régionale de l’Environnement de l’Aménagement et du Logement d'Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes)). A thunderstorm weir (WW) is a "work allowing the direct discharge of part of the effluent into the natural environment, when the upstream flow exceeds a certain value. Coverage: Administrateur de Données (Direction Régionale de l’Environnement de l’Aménagement et du Logement d'Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes)). The portal shows the English title as "Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes storm overflow (SEC time overflow) and the Rhône-Mediterranean basin" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administrateur de Données (Direction Régionale de l’Environnement de l’Aménagement et du Logement d'Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes)). Its keywords include inspire, assainissement, bourgogne-franche-comte, grand-public, sec, auvergne-rhone-alpes. The listing shows 5 download or service links in WFS, WMS, UTF8. The listing shows 2026-06-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
